## Anas v5.2.8

- 合并默认助手行为描述到「角色设定」，移除独立的「自定义指令」。旧指令保留在设置文件中，可按需手动复制到角色设定。
- Windows 运行环境精简 PowerShell 说明，命令工具继续提供版本和语法信息。
- 统一内容预览的复制图标，以及项目和文件编辑弹窗的窗口留白。调整文件编辑器的自动换行和最大化按钮样式。

- Consolidate the default assistant behavior into Role and remove the separate Instructions field. Previously saved instructions remain in the settings file and can be copied into Role.
- Simplify Windows runtime context. The PowerShell command tool still describes its version and syntax.
- Standardize copy icons in content previews and window insets for project and file editors. Refine the file editor’s auto-wrap and maximize controls.
